title: R Markdown workflow improvements
description:
This revises the manner in which the R Markdown workflow for data validations (in specialized code chunks) occurs. We no longer need to invoke a function to initialize the framework, using `library(pointblank)` in the setup chunk will do that automatically. The `validate_rmd()`, therefore has been repurposed for setup options only.

An R Markdown template has been added to easily get started with this workflow. The `stop_if_not()` function was created to make it easy to use simple assertions in this framework. Also, the appearance of the UI in the rendered documentation has been improved to show only what's necessary.

title: Improve the `col_schema_match()` & `expect_col_schema_match()` functions
description:
Add the `complete` and `in_order` arguments to the `col_schema_match()` and `expect_col_schema_match()` functions to relax constraints on completeness and ordering of columns defined in a `col_schema` object.

Fixes: #85

title: Use consistent messages in simple validations and expectations
description: This ensures that the error and warning messages match whether validation step functions are used directly on data (with the internal `stock_stoppage()` and `stock_warning()` functions), or, expectation functions are being used.

title: Quiet the interrogation if non-interactive; add `knit_print` method
description: The changes in this PR make it possible to add agent-based data validations inside of an R Markdown document. The status messages are automatically quieted and the resulting agent report table is now nicely printed in the chunk output.

title: Provide first implementation of .Rmd validation
description:
The `validate_rmd()` function sets up a framework for validation testing within specialized validation code chunks inside an R Markdown document. To enable this functionality, `validate_rmd()` should be called early within an R Markdown document code chunk (preferably in the `setup` chunk) to signal that validation should occur within specific code chunks. The validation code chunks require the `validate = TRUE` option to be set. 

Using **pointblank** validation step functions on data in these marked code chunks will flag
overall failure if the stop threshold is exceeded anywhere. All errors are reported in the validation code chunk after rendering the document to HTML, where a centered status button either indicates success or the number of overall failures. Clicking the button reveals the otherwise hidden validation statements and their error messages (if any).

An example .Rmd file is provided in `tests/manual_tests`.

title: Allow use of formula and function values for `preconditions`
description: This change allows for both formula and function values for `preconditions`. Internal utility functions were generated for evaluating both inputs on target tables. Documentation was modified and testthat tests were revised.

title: Add expectation function versions of validation step functions
description: This creates a matching `expect_...()` function for every validation step function in the package. With these new functions, we can then test tabular data using testthat testing.

title: Release v0.3.1
description:
This is the release branch for pointblank 0.3.1.

Fixes #83

title: Use gt package directly in package
description: This integrates **gt** more closely with the agent report and the HTML summary produced by `scan_data()`. We no longer need to use **gt** in the **drat** repository. All superfluous `requireNamespace()` calls are now removed.

title: Introduce the `scan_data()` function for getting an overview of a data table
description:
The `scan_data()` function generates an HTML report (which uses embedded Bootstrap and jQuery) with statistical summaries (also at the variable level). The idea is that this can be run prior to generating a pointblank validation (since you need to understand the data before making validation rules).

A quick example for running this report:

```r
scan_data(tbl = datasets::quakes)
```

Currently, there are no options for the generation of the report but that should be possible eventually. Even so, the report should scale well with data tables that are small or relatively large.

title: Update the project README
description: This PR updates the README.

title: Add several blastula `creds*()` fcns as reexports
description: These changes reexport several useful credentials helper functions from the blastula package.

title: Add enhanced tbl information and new step function
description: This PR adds more pertinent info about a table that’s a `tbl_dbi` in the agent object. Also, there’s a new validation step function for validating the table schema.

title: Add multilanguage support for reporting/briefs
description: This adds a `reporting_lang` option to `create_agent()` and allows for automatic briefs and agent reports to be in five different languages.

title: Improvements to automatically creating explanations for validation steps
description:
This PR refactors code around the `create_autobrief()` utility function. This also improves the messages and adds one for the `conjointly()` validation step function.

Fixes: https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/68
Fixes: https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/70

title: Print method for 'x-list'
description:
This makes printing an x-list much more informational.

Fixes: #69

title: Add a CLI to report on interrogation progress
description:
Using the **cli** package, messages are displayed to the console during an interrogation.

Fixes: https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/66.

title: Add option to make a validation step 'active' or not
description:
With this PR, each validation step function gets the argument `active`, which will accept a logical value (defaulting to `TRUE`).

If step functions are working with an agent, `FALSE` will make the step inactive (still reporting its presence and keeping indexes for the steps unchanged).

If the step functions are operating directly on data, then any step with `active = FALSE` will simply pass the data through, no longer acting as a filter (internally, just returning the data early).

Several testthat tests are added for this feature.

Fixes https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/60.

title: Sunder data
description:
This function evenly divides the input dataset into pass and fail pieces. This is post interrogation and based entirely on row-based validation steps. Not a bad solution to getting a data quality analysis and extracting the obviously good data from the input.

Tests were added to ensure that this works for data frames, tibbles, and `tbl_dbi` tables.

title: Add a way to specify default `action levels`
description: This adds the `actions` arg to `create_agent()` (and it knows how to use it).

title: Improve the report created by `get_agent_report()`
description: This improves the report generated by the `get_agent_report()` function.

title: Catch warnings and errors and add to reporting
description: This PR captures warnings and errors and places that information in the agent. Uses a special `tryCatch()` formulation to collect the warnings and errors. Reporting with `get_agent_report()` takes advantage of this new information.

title: Allow for comparisons across columns
description:
This PR allows the comparison value in several step functions to be *other columns* (and not fixed, literal values). The report generated by `get_agent_report()` is also upgraded to address the different value types.

Fixes #51

title: Simplify structure of agent; improve agent report
description:
This simplifies the internal structure of the agent object. Also, some minor improvements to the agent report object are made here.

Fixes #49.

title: Update the README
description: Aside from a README update, this also improves the printing of the table from using the `get_agent_report()` function.

title: Use a secret agent to work directly on tbls
description:
This unifies the methods for validation whether a full agent is used to gather intel, or a simple validation is done with a secret agent.

Fixes #41

title: Add tests for `conjointly()`
description: Fixes #38

title: Add the `conjointly()` function
description: This function allows for conjoint validations with validation step functions of the `col_vals_*()` type.

title: Implement the `actions` arg
description: Using the `action_levels()` helper function with the `actions` arg will allow for more possibilities in defining validation states and customizing the response to these conditions. This also cleans up the function signatures for all the validation step functions, which is a good thing.

title: Use the `incl_na` argument in more validation functions
description:
These changes put the `incl_na` argument in more of the validation functions.

Fixes https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/15.

title: Allow use of select helpers
description:
This PR makes it possible to use `vars()` and the **tidyselect** select helpers (e.g., `starts_with()`) when defining pointblank validation steps. Some of the earlier cruft was also removed here.

Fixes: https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/32.

title: Modify API to only use a single table per agent
description:
This PR ditches the `focus_on()` function and makes it easier to directly use the table object name (which is now an option in the `create_agent()` function).

Fixes https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/23.
Fixes https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/12.

title: Repurpose `preconditions` to be used for exprs
description:
The big change here is that `preconditions` can be used to temporarily transform the table (i.e., transforming for a particular validation step). This is useful for joining in a table, filtering rows, etc. 

Fixes https://github.com/rich-iannone/pointblank/issues/27.

title: Refactor the `interrogate()` function
description: The `interrogate()` function has been refactored slightly.

title: Incorporate options to stop a validation (both simple- and agent-based)
description:
This adds the `stop_count` and `stop_fraction` arguments to all validation step functions. If any of these options are enabled for a given validation step and the set threshold is met for the first time, the validation will stop with a descriptive message.

This is great for those times when automated tests of data just need to stop before something happens that probably shouldn't need to happen.

title: Correct error in function name for get_html_summary()
description: Fixes error where README.md incorrectly referred to html_summary() rather than get_html_summary() as the method for creating an HTML interrogation report.

title: Remove dependency on lazyWeave
description:
I will be submitting `pixiedust` to CRAN shortly.  In the update, I've taken away the dependency on `lazyWeave`.  I've removed it from the dependencies of `pointblank`. I did not change the minimum required version; even though I reported a critical bug, that bug only impacts LaTeX output.  Since you fix your output to HTML, it shouldn't be an issue for you to use 0.7.5.  I'll leave it to your discretion on whether to require 0.8.0.

I also made a code change in `utils.R`.  I recommended using `sprinkle_colnames` to rename columns in the table rather than `dplyr::rename`.  It's trivial, and I won't be hurt if you reject it.

title: Add tests for is_exact=FALSE with logical cols
description:
This PR adds new tests to improve validation of logical column types when using the `is_exact = FALSE` option in schema matching functions. These tests ensure that logical columns are correctly validated in both pipelines and direct function calls, catching cases where the column type does not match the expected schema.

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/670

title: fix: schema check fails supplied a data frame
description:
This PR fixes `col_schema()` and related schema-matching functions in two main ways: it allows a table to be passed as a positional argument to `col_schema()`, making the API more flexible, and it fixes a bug in the schema validation loop to ensure all columns are checked when `is_exact = FALSE`.

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/657

title: docs: remove log4r references
description:
This PR updates the documentation and examples to remove the use of the `log4r_step()` logging function (which has been removed from the package).

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/676

title: feat: CDISC conformance checks
description: This PR introduces a set of new internal modules and public exports to support CDISC conformance checks. We implement CDISC controlled terminology (CT) handling, there's a new a CDISC rule operations engine, and new a condition evaluator. These changes lay the groundwork for advanced CDISC validation features and expose several new user-facing functions.

title: feat: add  `col_vals_str_len()`
description:
This PR adds support for validating string lengths in column values, allowing users to specify minimum and maximum string lengths for data validation. It introduces the new `col_vals_str_len()` family of functions, integrates their logic into the validation pipeline, and provides appropriate messaging and YAML serialization support.

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/140

title: Docs: modernize examples and rename references
description: The focus of this PR is to update examples (safely move from `%>%` to `|>`) and rename references to the recently-revised warn, error, critical actions levels.

title: fix: pipe replacements
description: This PR refactors several R functions to adopt the native pipe operator (`|>`) instead of the magrittr pipe (`%>%`). These changes are meant to modernize the codebase, improve readability, and align with current R best practices.

title: docs: add article on YAML config
description:
This PR adds a new vignette/article detailing YAML-based validation workflows.

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/687

title: fix: change `col_vals_regex()` arg name to align with Python Pointblank
description:
This PR makes several changes to align the R package's naming conventions and argument names with those used in the Python version of pointblank. Here we rename the `regex` argument to `pattern` in the `col_vals_regex()` family of functions. The Deprecated argument name remains supported with warnings, and YAML compatibility is preserved. Documentation and examples have been updated accordingly.

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/685

title: Fix: align validation function naming with Python Pointblank
description:
This PR standardizes the naming of two validation functions to align with the Python version of pointblank. Specifically, `col_vals_gte()` and `col_vals_lte()` are renamed to `col_vals_ge()` and `col_vals_le()`, with the old names kept as soft-deprecated aliases for backward compatibility. The changes are reflected throughout the codebase, documentation, and exported interfaces.

Fixes: https://github.com/rstudio/pointblank/issues/684
